rows.en: Hmm… Open up a path for the assault team, whatever it takes! We have to draw the enemy's forces here…
By the way… the assault team is going to be all right, isn't it?
I've explained the whole operation to Mr. Tachibana. I'm sure they'll pull it off…
When all is said and done… the only reason we've been able to hold out this long is thanks to their strength…
We have to acknowledge it, don't we? Their existence, and their tremendous power…
Perhaps we too have reached a point where we need to think things over…
What do you mean by that, Staff Officer Yanagawa?

Don't you see?

What we're lacking in order to grasp true peace…?
True peace?

That's right…

Even if we win this battle, unless we change the way we think, we'll just repeat the same thing all over again.
Wh… What are you saying?

No… Staff Officer Yanagawa is right.

We've merely used the banner of a "strictly defensive" policy to protect our national interests… to line our own selfish pockets.

True peace…

Will they lead us to the answer?

I don't know…

But let's place our hopes in them! Our proud warriors…
So that's… the Space Fortress Naager? Look at the size of it.

But, Captain…

that's an illusion we humans have built up in our own minds! And if so… there's no reason we can't destroy it.

Kishida's right!

It's scary because you think it's scary… It's terrifying because you feel it's terrifying. Captain, let's go at it with confidence.
That's right… As long as we, MAT, are here, we won't let them do as they please!

…?

What's wrong, Oka? Is something bothering you?

…………

Captain, let's stop using the radio! The enemy mothership is this close. They might be intercepting our radio too.

Captain… something's definitely off!

It looks like some special radio wave is being discharged over this whole area, like a barrier.
All right… No radio contact except in emergencies! Oka, let the other units know too.
Yes, sir…
Heh heh heh… It seems they've noticed what we're up to.
What shall we do?

It was a fine diversion, but…

it seems we've spent a bit too much time on it. Begin preparations for the Naager's takeoff! We've cultivated plenty of Vol cells. We have no further use for Earth!

When the Naager roars and takes off, magma will spew from the tips of the tentacles as they're pulled out… And then the Earth will be blown away without a trace!

Yes, just as if nothing had ever been there at all! Hah hah hah…
As you command.
Atefarina… how far along is the analysis of the Vol genome?

Yes, sir…

I've analyzed its genetic system based on the DNA information…

From the genetic information written in the genome, I created a database of the gene base sequences, and have succeeded in almost fully explaining the life processes of Vol cells!
And…? Is it possible to multiply Vol cells and control them at will?
In theory, it's possible! However…
What is it?

The cells of a normal individual are diploid, with two genomes derived from a female gamete and a male gamete…

But we've found that Vol cells are a triploid life form with hermaphroditic gonads.
Hermaphroditic gonads?
In other words, Vol cells are a hermaphroditic life form.
Heh heh heh… Truly fascinating research results!

I'm honored by your praise! However…

Vol cells are a type of archaeal cell. Vol itself has no nucleus…

By fusing with the eukaryotic cells of higher animals such as humans, nuclear division occurs and it can sustain life, but it cannot undergo cell division!

By devouring the host's nucleus along with its DNA, a so-called complete takeover becomes possible… But… Vol cannot bear offspring.

What!?

We went to the trouble of gathering both male and female test subjects, and watched over their evolution all this time…

And you say the male and female EATERs are of no use!? That even if we can cultivate Vol cells, we can't make them breed!?

I'm afraid so…

As long as Vol ends up completely taking over its host… the host's genetic information is wiped out, and all you end up with is a single EATER!

Except for one method…
This is Muramatsu… What is it?
They say we can't use the radio from now on.
What do you mean?

Some special radio wave is being discharged over that whole area.

In other words… everything we say over the radio is going straight to the enemy!
What? Then…
Exactly! We just need to put out jamming signals. And building that is my job…
All right, Ide! Hurry!!

Yes, yes…

No rush, no rush! Good things come to those who wait, as they say… I'll get it done properly, so just relax and wait.

Geez… This might be the final battle, and he's that laid-back!

And Hayata went out on patrol and hasn't checked in since! What on earth is going to happen?
An assault…!?
On that monstrosity…?
Yes, that's right! You're the only ones left who can save the Earth!
I understand that, but…
No! We have to do it! We're the only ones who can!

That's Takeshi for you…

That's right, there's nothing else for it! Not if we're going to save mankind… and this Earth.
Let's do it! We'll protect our Earth with our own hands.
But how!?

…!?

What do you mean, how?
Well… around that space fortress there's a Dimensional Distortion Field…!
A Dimensional Distortion Field?
That's right…
What is it? This dimensional-whatchamacallit field?
Basically, it's like an invisible barrier… a powerful, impenetrable shield stretched all around it.
No… even so, if we could just do something about the entrance…
That space fortress doesn't have any entrances or exits.
What!? No… entrances or exits?
Then how do they…?
The Dimensional Distortion Field serves as the way in and out, apparently. It's like an invisible door…
The one controlling the Dimensional Distortion Field is Atefarina the Battle Princess.
Atefarina the Battle Princess? You mean that top Naager officer who stormed into the Far East Base?
That's right…
What the heck!?

Sure… I think the only way to destroy that space fortress is to target the power reactor inside…

But… that ship isn't so flimsy that we can just slip inside.
Then…

I hate to say it…

but we've lost!
Then… why don't we just nab this Atefarina and make her talk!
Taki… if you were Atefarina, what would you do?

Well… uh…

Damn it! What are we supposed to do?
There's just one… one last way left.
No, [HERO2]!!

uncertain: U13792: 専守防衛 rendered "strictly defensive" policy (Japan-style defense-only doctrine).
U13797: 我々人類が造った虚像 read as 'an illusion we humans have built up in our own minds' (fear makes it look invincible), matching U13798.
U13814-U13818: pseudo-biology translated literally; 西性腺 read as 両性腺 (hermaphroditic gonads), 核分裂 as 'nuclear division'.
U13819: 雄雌それぞれの被験者 = the hero and heroine as test subjects (EATERs).
U13847: subject 'they' (the Naager) supplied for どうやって.

new_names.why: not in glossary; follows the Vol- attack names
